reasons: The 4 MC per-semester limit allows at most one of the required 4-MC courses each semester, but six required courses must fit into semesters 4-8 (five semesters).
CS3231, CS2102 and CS3264 must all be in the same semester because CS2102 must pair with each, requiring 12 MC in one semester, above the 4 MC limit.
